benefit.original_text: Up to ₹5 Lakhs financial assistance for illness treatment and full subsidy on high-end diagnostics

required_documents: Voter ID card showing 3 years residency in Delhi
Referral letter & treatment estimate from Delhi Govt Hospital
application_steps: 1. Obtain treatment estimate and DAK application form from treating Delhi Govt Hospital.
2. Submit form to Medical Superintendent / DAK Cell at Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
3. Financial sanction issued directly to hospital.
manual_verification_reason: Medical superintendent endorsement and income verification from revenue authorities are mandatory.

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Health Insurance Scheme - Nagaland (CMHISN)
target_beneficiary: Indigenous and permanent residents of Nagaland

eligibility.residence_requirement: Indigenous inhabitant or permanent resident of Nagaland

annual_income.original_text: No income cap (Categorized into CMHIS GEN and CMHIS EP)

other_conditions: Must be an Indigenous Inhabitant of Nagaland (IIC) or permanent resident holding valid documents
Excludes beneficiaries covered under central CGHS
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: State: Nagaland; Resident: Indigenous inhabitant / Permanent resident; Covers General and Government Employee categories

benefit.description: Cashless hospitalization coverage of ₹5,00,000 per family per year on floater basis (up to ₹20,00,000 for government employee category)
benefit.original_text: ₹5,00,000 per family per annum cashless health cover

required_documents: Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate (IIC) or Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC)
application_steps: 1. Register online on the CMHIS Nagaland portal or at common service centres.
2. Verification of indigenous documents and e-Card generation.

scheme_name: Scheme for Adolescent Girls (SAG)
target_beneficiary: Out-of-school adolescent girls aged 11-14 years

eligibility.residence_requirement: Citizen of India residing in project districts
other_conditions: Must identify as female
Must be out of school (dropped out or never enrolled)
Must attend local Anganwadi Centre activities
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Gender: Female; Age: 11 to 14 years; Schooling status: Out-of-school girl

benefit.description: Supplementary Nutrition (take-home ration / hot cooked meals), iron-folic acid supplementation, health checkups, and life-skill counselling to facilitate mainstream schooling
benefit.original_text: Supplementary nutrition (600 calories & 18-20g protein/day) and non-nutrition health/skill support

application_steps: 1. Enroll directly at the local Anganwadi Centre under Poshan 2.0 / ICDS project.
2. Anganwadi Worker verifies age and out-of-school status.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
target_beneficiary: All Indian citizens, patients, individual pharmacists, and NGOs

other_conditions: Medicines available to any citizen presenting a valid prescription
For opening a Kendra: applicant must hold D.Pharm/B.Pharm or employ a registered pharmacist and have 120 sq ft commercial space
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Beneficiary: All citizens. Kendra Opening: D.Pharm/B.Pharm holder or organization employing one with suitable shop premise

benefit.description: Access to high-quality generic medicines and surgical products at 50% to 90% lower prices; Kendras receive up to ₹5 Lakh financial incentive
benefit.original_text: 50% to 90% savings on medicines compared to branded market alternatives

application_steps: 1. To purchase: Walk in to any PMBJP Kendra with prescription.
2. To establish Kendra: Apply online on janaushadhi.gov.in portal.

scheme_name: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)
target_beneficiary: Children studying in Balvatika and Classes 1 to 8 in Government and Government-aided schools

age.original_text: Primary and Upper Primary school-age children

eligibility.residence_requirement: Enrolled in participating school in India
other_conditions: Must be regularly enrolled and attending classes 1 to 8 in eligible government/aided school
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Children enrolled in Balvatika and Classes 1 to 8 in Government, Government-aided, and local body schools

benefit.description: Free hot cooked mid-day meal on all school working days providing prescribed nutrition (450 calories/12g protein for primary, 700 calories/20g protein for upper primary)
benefit.original_text: Free nutritious hot cooked meal every school day

required_documents: Aadhaar Card (voluntary / as per school norms)
application_steps: Automatic benefit upon school enrollment; no separate application required.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
target_beneficiary: Students with disabilities studying in post-matriculation courses

disability_percentage.original_text: 40% or more disability certified by competent medical authority

annual_income.original_text: Parental/Family annual income from all sources does not exceed ₹2,50,000

other_conditions: Holds a valid Disability Certificate with 40%+ disability
Studying in a recognized post-matric course
Not holding any other central scholarship
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Disability: 40% and above; Education: Class 11 up to Post Graduation; Income: Family income <= ₹2,50,000 per annum

benefit.description: Maintenance allowance, disability allowance, book grant, and reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees
benefit.original_text: Monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,600 + disability allowance up to ₹4,000/annum + tuition fee reimbursement

required_documents: Fee receipt and bonafide student certificate
application_steps: 1. Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
2. Select Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities.
3. Submit application for institutional and state verification.

scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
target_beneficiary: Scheduled Caste students studying in classes 9 and 10

annual_income.original_text: Parental annual income from all sources does not exceed ₹2,50,000

other_conditions: Belongs to Scheduled Caste (SC) community
Regular student of Class 9 or 10 in a recognized school
Only two children of the same parents are eligible
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Category: Scheduled Caste (SC); Education: Classes 9 and 10; Family annual income: Up to ₹2,50,000

benefit.description: Academic allowance of ₹3,500 per annum for day scholars and ₹7,000 per annum for hostellers paid via DBT
benefit.original_text: ₹3,500/annum for day scholars, ₹7,000/annum for hostellers

application_steps: 1. Apply via State scholarship portal or National Scholarship Portal (NSP).
2. Verification by school principal and district welfare officer.

scheme_name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child
target_beneficiary: Single girl children pursuing regular non-professional master's degree

age.original_text: Up to 30 years at the time of admission in PG first year

other_conditions: Must be the only child in the family (girl without brother/sister, or twin/fraternal daughters)
Admitted to regular, full-time 1st year Master’s program in a recognized university
Distance education mode is not eligible
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Gender: Female; Status: Single girl child (only child); Age <= 30; Enrolled in 1st year regular PG course

benefit.description: ₹36,200 per annum for a period of two years (full duration of PG course)
benefit.original_text: ₹36,200 per annum for 2 years

required_documents: Proof of admission to regular PG 1st year
Affidavit on ₹50 stamp paper from SDM/First Class Magistrate verifying single girl child status
application_steps: 1. Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).
2. Select UGC schemes -> PG Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child.
3. Upload magistrate affidavit and get verified by university nodal officer.
manual_verification_reason: Requires validation of judicial stamp affidavit authenticating single child status.

scheme_name: Fellowship Scheme for Minority/SC/ST/Women Pursuing Higher Education
target_beneficiary: SC, ST, Minority, and Women scholars pursuing full-time Ph.D. or M.Phil.

age.original_text: Up to 35 years (relaxation for reserved categories as per UGC norms)

annual_income.original_text: Annual family income not exceeding ₹6,00,000 (where applicable)

other_conditions: Must be registered for regular and full-time M.Phil/Ph.D.
Candidate must have qualified UGC-NET / CSIR-NET or institutional entrance exam
Must not receive any other parallel fellowship
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Scholars from SC/ST/Minority or Female researchers registered for regular Ph.D./M.Phil.

benefit.description: Monthly fellowship of ₹31,000 (JRF equivalent) for first 2 years, ₹35,000 (SRF) for remaining period plus contingency grants and HRA
benefit.original_text: ₹31,000 to ₹35,000 per month + HRA + contingency grant

application_steps: 1. Apply online via UGC / Ministry portal when notification is released.
2. Institutional verification by university registrar.
manual_verification_reason: Requires verification of research registration, guide endorsement, and progress reports.

scheme_name: Upgrading Skills and Training in Traditional Arts/Crafts for Development
target_beneficiary: Traditional master craftspersons, artisans, and minority youth

other_conditions: Belongs to 6 notified minority communities
Interested in learning or upgrading heritage craft skills
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Age: 14 to 45; Category: Minority communities; Focus on traditional crafts and heritage trades

benefit.description: Free skill training, master craftsman training, monthly stipend of ₹1,500 to ₹3,000, toolkit support, and certification
benefit.original_text: Free training + stipend + toolkit allowance

application_steps: 1. Apply via implementing partner agency or direct training centre registration.
2. Biometric attendance and training batch enrollment.

scheme_name: Nari Adalat
target_beneficiary: Rural women seeking alternate dispute resolution for non-cognizable disputes

eligibility.residence_requirement: Resident of the implementing Gram Panchayat / Block
other_conditions: Open to women facing family/domestic disputes, social ostracization, or civil denial of rights
Disputes must be non-cognizable and amenable to conciliation and mediation
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Women residents facing social or domestic grievances requiring mediation at the Panchayat level

benefit.description: Informal, community-based alternate dispute resolution, free legal counseling, emotional support, and awareness of legal rights
benefit.original_text: Free grievance resolution, mediation, and legal counseling

required_documents: Aadhaar Card or local residence identity proof
Written or oral grievance application to Nyaya Sakhi
application_steps: 1. Approach the local Gram Panchayat Nari Adalat / Nyaya Sakhis.
2. Register dispute for mediation and joint conciliation sessions.

scheme_name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
target_beneficiary: Meritorious students from economically weaker sections studying in class 9 to 12

annual_income.original_text: Parental income from all sources not exceeding ₹3,50,000 per annum

other_conditions: Minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade in Class 7 and 8 (50% for SC/ST)
Must qualify the state-level NMMSS selection test conducted for Class 8
Students of Kendriya Vidyalayas, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, and residential schools are ineligible
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Class 8 passed with min 55% marks; Qualified NMMSS exam; Parental income <= ₹3,50,000; Enrolled in govt/aided school

benefit.description: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) from Class 9 to Class 12 via DBT
benefit.original_text: ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000 per month)

application_steps: 1. Qualify state-level Class 8 selection test.
2. Register and submit application on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
3. School and district level verification.

scheme_name: WIDUSHI (Women's Instinct for Developing and Ushering in Scientific Heights & Innovations)
target_beneficiary: Senior women scientists and researchers nearing retirement or without permanent regular employment

other_conditions: Must hold a Ph.D. in Basic or Applied Sciences or equivalent degree
Excellent publication and research track record
Must be associated with an Indian host institution providing laboratory facilities
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Gender: Female; Age: 57 to 62 years; Qualification: Ph.D. in S&T; Must have host institution

benefit.description: Consolidated research fellowship of ₹75,000 to ₹85,000 per month, research grant of ₹5 Lakh per year, and institutional overhead
benefit.original_text: Monthly fellowship of ₹75,000–₹85,000 + research grant of ₹5,00,000/year for up to 3 years

required_documents: Endorsement certificate from Head of Host Institution
Curriculum Vitae with list of publications
application_steps: 1. Submit research proposal through DST’s ePMS portal (onlinedst.gov.in).
2. Presentation and evaluation before DST Expert Committee.
manual_verification_reason: Scientific merit and project deliverables evaluated by DST Subject Expert Committee.

scheme_name: Visvesvaraya Ph.D. Scheme for Electronics and IT
target_beneficiary: Full-time and Part-time Ph.D. candidates in ESDM and IT/ITES sectors

age.original_text: As per institutional Ph.D. admission guidelines

institution_type: Empaneled premier institutions (IITs, NITs, Central/State Universities)
other_conditions: Enrolled in Ph.D. in Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) or IT/ITES
Admitted through institutional screening into an empaneled Visvesvaraya Scheme institution
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Enrolled in Ph.D. in ESDM / IT-ITES at empaneled academic institution

benefit.description: Fellowship of ₹38,750 per month (years 1-2) and ₹43,750 per month (years 3-5), annual contingency grant of ₹30,00, and reimbursement of rent
benefit.original_text: Fellowship up to ₹43,750/month + contingency grant + international conference support up to ₹50,000

required_documents: Ph.D. admission offer letter from empaneled institute
application_steps: 1. Secure Ph.D. admission in an empaneled institution.
2. Institute recommends candidate through Digital India Corporation / MeitY portal.
manual_verification_reason: Administered directly via participating premier universities and academic institutions.

scheme_name: Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship
target_beneficiary: Distinguished Indian engineers and translational research innovators

institution_type: Publicly funded institutions, universities, national labs
other_conditions: Must hold a regular salaried position in an Indian academic institution or research lab
Track record of translating research into commercial technology, patents, or industry solutions
Must be nominated by heads of recognized institutions or INAE fellows
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Indian engineer/scientist with verified translational research and commercialized technology track record

benefit.description: Fellowship incentive of ₹25,000 per month (in addition to salary), research grant of ₹15 Lakh per year, and overhead allowance of ₹1 Lakh per year for up to 5 years
benefit.original_text: ₹25,000/month fellowship incentive + ₹15 Lakh/year research grant

required_documents: Curriculum Vitae detailing commercialized patents, technology transfers, and engineering achievements
application_steps: 1. Submit nomination through Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE) / SERB portal.
2. Scrutiny and selection by INAE-SERB joint search-cum-selection committee.
manual_verification_reason: Nomination-based fellowship evaluating technological impact, industry transfers, and commercialized patents.

scheme_name: Scheme of Encouragement to Young Artists (SEYA)
target_beneficiary: Young practicing artists in classical, folk, and traditional performing arts

eligibility.residence_requirement: Resident of Goa for minimum 15 years
other_conditions: 15 years continuous residence certificate in Goa
Demonstrated outstanding talent in music, dance, theatre, visual arts, or traditional Goan art forms
Undergoing formal training under a recognized Guru or institution
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: State: Goa; Age: 18 to 25 years; Residence: Minimum 15 years; Active practitioner in fine or performing arts

benefit.description: Monthly scholarship of ₹3,000 to ₹5,000 for advanced artistic training and guru shishya mentorship
benefit.original_text: Monthly scholarship allowance for arts training

required_documents: Recommendation / Certificate from recognized Guru or music/dance academy
application_steps: 1. Obtain application form from Directorate of Art and Culture, Govt of Goa.
2. Submit form with guru endorsement and audition portfolio.
3. Audition interview before selection committee.
manual_verification_reason: Audition and performance assessment by expert cultural panel.

scheme_name: Yuva Srujan Puraskar (Navsarjan Chetana Puraskar)
target_beneficiary: Young Goan achievers in art, culture, literature, and social contribution

eligibility.residence_requirement: Goan origin or resident of Goa for minimum 15 years
other_conditions: Resident of Goa for at least 15 years
Substantial independent contributions and awards in performing arts, visual arts, literature, folk art, or cinema
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: State: Goa; Age: 25 to 40 years; 15 years residence; Recognized artistic contribution

benefit.description: State honour comprising a cash award of ₹25,000, memento, certificate, and public felicitation on Goa Liberation Day
benefit.original_text: ₹25,000 cash purse + citation + memento

required_documents: Detailed resume of cultural accomplishments, press clippings, and awards
application_steps: 1. Nominations invited by Directorate of Art & Culture, Panaji, Goa.
2. Scrutiny by expert advisory committee.
manual_verification_reason: State honours awarded on the evaluation of lifetime artistic impact and jury selection.

scheme_name: Assistance for Maintenance and Operational Cost of Cultural Spaces (SHRDS-AMOCSP)
target_beneficiary: Non-profit cultural organizations, registered trusts, and societies operating performance spaces

institution_type: Registered Society / Trust under Societies Registration Act
other_conditions: Organization registered for minimum 3 years under Societies Registration Act or relevant statute
Operating an active cultural studio, rehearsal space, or auditorium dedicated to arts promotion
eligibility.original_eligibility_text: Registered non-profit cultural organization with at least 3 years active cultural performances and physical space operations

benefit.description: Annual financial grant up to ₹5 Lakhs to meet maintenance, electricity, rental, and operational expenditures of cultural spaces
benefit.original_text: Grant-in-aid up to ₹5,00,000 for maintenance and operational overheads

required_documents: 3 years audited balance sheets and annual activity reports
PAN Card and NGO Darpan Unique ID
application_steps: 1. Apply through Ministry of Culture CSMS portal (csms.nic.in).
2. State Government / ZCC recommendation.
3. Review by Expert Advisory Committee on Cultural Spaces.
manual_verification_reason: Requires inspection of cultural hall/studio operations, NGO Darpan verification, and audited financial statements.
